text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry. I'm really, really, really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I just... I'm so... so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Why are you so nice to me, Trainer? I... I
don't deserve your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't! I'm... I'm hopeless,
worthless—useless!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I tried to change myself, you know. Not
just this time... so many
times.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was hard moving away from Mother, but
I still came to Tracen
Academy. I trained
so much, and I even signed up for races!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... it was no good. Whenever I think
about running in an actual
race, I get so
scared... Like at the tryouts, like now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That I'll never become a blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That even if I enter a race, I won't be able
to make even a single
person happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That once I run, I'll find out the truth—that
I'm a good-for-nothing...
Not just now, but
forever after too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When I think about all that... I get so
scared, and I can't stop
trembling!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. You don't need to put
up with me... You shouldn't
put up with me
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-well... But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You'll stay by my side no matter what?
You believe... that I can still
change?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hm, hmmm! Hm, hm, hmmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You can do this, Rice! Believe in yourself...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, Rice! You came out!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Urara, you waited for me this whole
time?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Rice, are you gonna race? Then I'll
be cheering for you! You can
do it, Riiice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara... Yeah! Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I can do this—yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(My legs... and my hands... they're still
shaking. And my fingers are
ice cold!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (But—)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Well, um, I—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right. Here... I go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (I... I hate myself.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(All I do is bring misfortune upon others
and cause trouble. For as
long as I can
remember, I've hated myself.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (But maybe now...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And they round the third turn! Running up
from the outside, it's the
jet-black
racer—Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (I will change! I won't give up! I won't be the same, weak girl any longer—never again!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Because even I... can bloom into a
beautiful blue rose that brings
people
happiness!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
200 meters left until the finish line, and
Rice Shower leads the pack!
It's a fierce
fight for first on this final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
100 meters remaining! Who will emerge
victorious?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I will... become the me I've always wanted
to beeeee!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Finish! A fierce battle, but Rice Shower
takes the title! A round of
applause for
your winner, Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaah!!! Woooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Nice goin', Rice Shower! Now that's what I
call a good race!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was on the edge of my seat! I'll come to
your next race for sure!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Um, can I make a selfish request?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mhm. Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'd really like... to call you Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'd really like... to call you Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Would that be... okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?! Th-then!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I really want to keep training with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister!
